services.name: Private Events
services.desc: OPTION 1. Non-private event. Free of charge. During business hours Wednesday & Thursday 3-10 pm, Friday & Saturday 12-10 pm, or Sunday 2-8 pm. If you plan to bring your group and eat whatever food option is available on your date, you are welcome to come out and find a table to hang out in the Biergarten. We cannot hold a space or tables with this option. We ask that you do not decorate or bring your music. We are ok with you bringing in a cake for this option. We do not allow outside food or beverages in, but we do have a kitchen serving food throughout the day, and a food truck in the evening. We serve beer, wine, cider, seltzer and non-alcoholic options. blurb: We are a family-owned, dog-friendly microbrewery and taproom offering 18 rotating taps of beer, cider, seltzer, and more, all crafted right here on site. Our brewery features a 1.3-acre beer garden, one of the largest in Florida, with plenty of space to relax, stroll with your pup, or gather for events, markets, and celebrations.
